title: soup witch
pitch: run a witch's soup cart. a frog wants something that tastes like a puddle with ambition. stir weird soups, fill the recipe book, don't let the tax goblin take the cart.
how_to: customers order in riddles. each riddle hints at the tastes they secretly want.
tap 2-3 ingredients into the cauldron, stir, serve. stirring reveals what each ingredient tastes like.
match their wants (and dodge allergies) for tips. every new soup goes in the recipe book.
5 days a season, rent every night. spend the rest at the night market on ingredients, upgrades and decorations.
controls: tap ingredients to drop them in the cauldron (2-4), then stir, then serve. keyboard: number keys (and q w e r...) pick ingredients, enter or space stirs and serves, backspace dumps, b opens the recipe book, m = sound, p = pause.
